scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @lead/server" "npm run dev -w @lead/web"
scripts.dev:demo: npm run build -w @lead/contracts && npm run dev -w @lead/web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @lead/contracts && npm run build -w @lead/database
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @lead/server && npm run build -w @lead/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:packages && npm run migrate -w @lead/database
